reason: All 11 remaining hits are a port declaration beside its implementation — AnalyticsRecorder/SqlAlchemyServerEventRecorder, DocumentRepository/SqlAlchemyDocumentStorage, RegistrationContextRecorder/RecordRegistrationContext, and a subclass constructor restating what it extends. The rule slides a 6-line window over the source and normalises string literals away, so a multi-line parameter list written once in the port and once in the adapter hashes identically. That is not duplication; it is what implementing an interface means in Python, and the only way to make the two differ is to write worse code. The three GENUINE duplications this rule found were fixed in 6f318720 (the verification refusal factories, idempotency-key validation, and the insert/conflict/recover order) — the waiver covers the residue, not the finding.

All 12 remaining hits are JSX composition bodies. The TSX counter is a brace-matching heuristic that treats one `return (...)` as a single block, so a component whose entire body is `
{five children}
` measures 70 lines while holding no logic at all — ProjectsPage is four hook calls and five children, and the Stage B judgment pass read the same files and scored component responsibility PASS. Splitting a screen's composition root across two files to satisfy a line count buys indirection and costs the reader. The two hits that were genuinely long LOGIC — send()'s four rethrow branches and useProjectActions' single-flight rule — were fixed in 33662d1f. Re-review if a hit ever appears in a file that is not pure composition.
